title: "Technical Manual"

Technical documentation for the bgms C++ backend, MCMC algorithms, and R
scaffolding layer. This manual targets contributors to bgms development,
users who need to understand implementation details, and researchers
extending bgms for new model types.

## Architecture

How the R front-end and C++ back-end are organized, and how they
communicate.

- [C++ Architecture](architecture.qmd) — Source layout, layer separation, design principles
- [R Scaffolding](r-scaffolding.qmd) — Validation, spec construction, sampler dispatch, output assembly
- [Model Classes](model-classes.qmd) — `BaseModel` hierarchy and virtual interface

## MCMC Engine

The sampling machinery shared by all models.

- [Sampler Hierarchy](samplers.qmd) — `SamplerBase`, gradient-based samplers, factory dispatch
- [NUTS Algorithm](nuts.qmd) — Binary tree construction, U-turn criterion, divergence detection
- [Constrained Leapfrog (RATTLE)](rattle.qmd) — Position/momentum projection, reversibility check, Memoizer
- [Warmup Schedule](warmup.qmd) — Five-stage adaptation, dual averaging, mass matrix tuning
- [Parallel Chains](parallel-chains.qmd) — TBB threading, model cloning, per-chain RNG

## Models

Model-specific sampling and likelihood computation.

- [GGM Internals](ggm-internals.qmd) — Precision matrix Metropolis, Cholesky rank-1 updates
- [OMRF Internals](omrf-internals.qmd) — Ordinal thresholds, Blume-Capel, pseudolikelihood
- [Variable Helpers](variable-helpers.qmd) — Numerically stable probability computation (FAST/SAFE)
- [Mixed MRF Internals](mixed-internals.qmd) — NUTS + precision Metropolis, block parameter layout, RATTLE

## Priors & Edge Selection

Prior specification and edge inclusion machinery.

- [Edge Priors](edge-priors.qmd) — Bernoulli, Beta-Bernoulli, and SBM prior classes
- [SBM Prior](sbm-prior.qmd) — MFM-SBM formulation, collapsed Gibbs, cluster allocation

## Group Comparison

- [bgmCompare Engine](bgmcompare-internals.qmd) — Multi-group posterior, difference selection

## Numerical Methods

- [Numerical Considerations](numerical.qmd) — Cross-platform exp/log, OpenLibM, IEEE 754 compliance

## Prerequisites

This manual assumes familiarity with C++ programming, MCMC methods,
and the No-U-Turn Sampler. The [User's Guide](../guide/index.qmd)
covers the statistical background at a conceptual level.
